lines.text: Gosh, I can barely breathe in this thing... Huh?
Onion-flavored Splendamin? For real?
Yeah, so what if I took off my mask. I felt like I was suffocating in that thing!

It's a wonderful thing to feel like you belong.
It makes me look forward to my days off.

They said from then on I could take off my facemask when kissing.
Kiss who? Well... you already know the answer to that.

I don't know why, but I'm always at ease around you, Commander.
So I'm sticking with you.
Commander, we've been assigned a mission... should we go?

I don't mean to be rude, but can we speed this up?
I promised my guildmates I'd be back for a raid.
I like the church. It's nice and quiet, and makes for a good hiding spot.
The Outpost is perfect for putting your feet up and taking a load off.
That looks like a good place for a lie down.
What's under the mask? Why, a beautiful face, of course!
I could care less about the upgrades. I just want to lie down.
E-excuse me. Is there more?
Please give me more next time.
Ah... If only you could give me something else...
A gift? For free?
Thanks. You're not gonna get on my case if I sell it, are you?
I always want to be by your side. I mean that.
So, when are you planning on getting a marriage certificate?

I love you.
Sorry, was that too sudden? Nevertheless, I still love you.
Me? Do I have to?
Huh? Me?
Carry me...
Time to fight, I suppose.
Let's get this over with.
Before we begin, Commander, can I possibly have a cookie?
If only there was someone else to take my place...
I'll reload.
There should be a reload fairy that takes care of this.
Do I have to reload by myself?
Mask open.
Kotodama, the power hidden within ones words.
Everyone's firing all at once... Will anyone notice if I don't?
Huh? They're down already?
Target down.
What a weakling.
Ah!
Urgh!
No!
Huh? S-sorry.
Ahh... So annoying... Um, did you hear that?
